name: Nyírlugos (Hungary)
description: White field with a red horizontal stripe along the top edge and a yellow stripe along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the town arms of Nyírlugos: a crowned blue and white shield with a stag, bars and a ploughshare, within a wreath of roses, above a scroll inscribed NYÍRLUGOS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nyírlugos arms with crown, wreath and scroll
